semantic.justification: Native Markdown filter path for represented Writer content; complete upstream parity remains unverified. InsertHtmlData now uses the original SAL UTF16-to-UTF8 conversion and existing SvStream, passing the real Markdown SwDoc and borrowed SwPaM to the consumed native SwHTMLParser. The private document callback begins at a blank paragraph at section EOF; unconsumed SwReader/Sfx media orchestration is not recreated as a generic API prerequisite. Empty path/baseURL and ignored parser result follow the pinned Markdown caller, and EndHtmlBlock clears its buffer after successful insertion. Actual native HTML/model/worker-codec tests replace the unsupported-placeholder fixture. This is initial connected HTML body/inline/block coverage, not full CSS/named-style/font/link/list/table HTML support.
